case.summary: Customer C11923 reported unrecognized transaction 3583368 for $131.30 on card C11923-K2. Investigation shows the transaction originated from a new mobile device. Card window analysis reveals 84 transactions in 48 hours with suspicious near-identical amounts prior to the flagged transaction. Three similar closed cases all resulted in confirmed fraud. Fraud probability assessed at 0.85 based on customer report, new device, and historical precedents.

initial.reason: R1: must propose VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER or STEP_UP_AUTH before BLOCK_CARD when p < 0.7 initially; also required to confirm fraud before final actions

final.reason: R1: after verification proposed, block permitted for single card compromise
R8: uncertain verdict with exposure > $500 requires ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST

next_best_actions.what_changed: Added BLOCK_CARD and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST after initial verification proposal per R1 and R8.

sar.reason: Fraud probability 0.85 but verdict remains uncertain pending customer verification; §3a requires fraud confirmed or strongly suspected AND one of: exposure > $1000, shared device/region connection to another customer fraud, or coordinated pattern. Exposure is $131.30 (<$1000) and no direct evidence of coordination with another customer's fraud yet confirmed.

stop_reason: §6 stop: p >= 0.85 reached with customer report, new device evidence, and matching closed cases (>=2 independent pieces of evidence).
